date:jesus-ascends-to-heaven@22ede5.note: Ascension comes after forty days following the passion (1.3). The text gives no year; AD 30 depends on outside chronology.

date:matthias-replaces-judas@22ede5.note: Happens after the ascension and before Pentecost (1.12-26). The text gives no year; AD 30 depends on outside chronology.

date:peter-preaches-at-pentecost@22ede5.note: Happens on the day of Pentecost (2.1). The text gives no year; AD 30 depends on outside chronology.

date:the-church-grows@22ede5.note: Growth starts the day of Pentecost (2.41) and continues daily (2.47). The text gives no year; AD 30 depends on outside chronology.

date:the-holy-spirit-comes@22ede5.note: Happens on the day of Pentecost (2.1-4). The text gives no year; AD 30 depends on outside chronology.

date:the-holy-spirit-is-promised@22ede5.note: Promised during the forty days (1.3), 'not many days hence' before Pentecost (1.5). The text gives no year; AD 30 depends on outside chronology.

member-of:lebbaeus_1815>apostles-post-as.note: Acts 1.13 names 'Judas the brother of James' (Luke 6.16), not Lebbaeus. Matt 10.3 names Lebbaeus Thaddaeus. Equating them is a reading.

member-of:lebbaeus_1815>apostles-the-ele.note: Acts 1.13 names 'Judas the brother of James' (Luke 6.16), not Lebbaeus. Matt 10.3 names Lebbaeus Thaddaeus. Equating them is a reading.

member-of:james_719>apostles-post-ascens.note: 1.13 names the James who is with Peter and John, one of the eleven. Jesus' brethren are listed apart from the apostles in 1.14.

member-of:james_719>apostles-the-eleven@.note: 1.13 names the James who is with Peter and John, one of the eleven. Jesus' brethren are listed apart from the apostles in 1.14.

occurred-at:jesus-ascends-to-heaven>oliv.note: The text does not name the spot. 1.12 says they returned from Olivet right after the ascension, so Olivet is a reading.

occurred-at:the-church-grows>jerusalem_6.note: 2.46 places the believers daily in the temple. Jerusalem is implied by 2.14, not stated for the growth itself.

occurred-at:the-holy-spirit-comes>jerusa.note: They were told not to leave Jerusalem (1.4) and were all in one place at Pentecost (2.1). Jerusalem is implied, not stated for the event.

occurred-at:the-holy-spirit-is-promised>.note: 1.4 has them told not to depart from Jerusalem, and Olivet is a sabbath day's journey away (1.12). The text implies Jerusalem, not Olivet.

participated-in:andrew_264>matthias-repl.note: Named among the eleven in the upper room (1.13). They appointed the two and cast lots (1.23-26), so taking part is a reading of that group action.

participated-in:barsabas_1720>matthias-r.note: Put forward as one of the two (1.23) but not chosen (1.26). He is the subject of the choice rather than an actor, so this is a reading.

participated-in:bartholomew_405>matthias.note: Named among the eleven in the upper room (1.13). They appointed the two and cast lots (1.23-26), so taking part is a reading of that group action.

participated-in:god_1324>jesus-ascends-t.note: 1.6 names 'Lord', which is Jesus, not God. God's part is only implied: 2.33 says Jesus was exalted by God's right hand.

participated-in:god_1324>the-holy-spirit.note: God says he will pour out his Spirit (2.17), which 2.16 says is fulfilled here. 2.33 links the Spirit to the Father's promise.

participated-in:holy_spirit_7400>the-hol.note: The Spirit is the promised gift, the object of the promise rather than an actor in it, so this is a reading.
